events.headline: Your Teacher Raises The Bar
events.detail: Your effort is visible enough that an ambitious teacher stops accepting your first answer.
narrativeVariants: Your effort is visible enough that an ambitious teacher stops accepting your first answer.
The work earns attention, then immediately earns a harder standard.

choices.title: Meet the standard
choices.detail: Accept more work and less margin.
choices.narrative: You meet the demand. Pride and exhaustion arrive together.

choices.title: Protect your margin
choices.detail: Let good work be enough this time.
choices.narrative: You leave the extra work undone and keep a piece of the evening.

events.headline: A Friend Opens Another Door
events.detail: An outgoing friend pulls you into a room where nobody knows your old story.

choices.title: Go with them
choices.detail: Spend energy on unfamiliar people.
choices.narrative: You enter as somebody's guest and leave with names of your own.

choices.title: Keep tonight small
choices.detail: Choose familiarity over another room.
choices.narrative: You stay home. The invitation does not become a memory.

events.headline: The Recession Rewards Your Caution
events.detail: The economy contracts, but the margin you protected keeps one bad month from becoming a collapse.

choices.title: Hold the buffer
choices.detail: Keep protecting the floor.
choices.narrative: You choose safety again. It is not glamorous, but it holds.

choices.title: Use the opening
choices.detail: Risk some safety while others retreat.
choices.narrative: You spend part of the buffer on a narrow opening.

events.headline: Your Voice Starts Carrying Further
events.detail: A routine group decision bends toward you because people trust how you frame the stakes.

choices.title: Take responsibility
choices.detail: Own the decision and its consequences.
choices.narrative: People follow the plan. They also remember whose plan it was.

choices.title: Share the room
choices.detail: Use influence without claiming control.
choices.narrative: You make space for another voice and lose none of your own.

events.headline: Your Care Becomes Someone's Shelter
events.detail: A friend brings you something heavy because your quiet loyalty has always felt safer than advice.

choices.title: Stay with them
choices.detail: Give the problem your full attention.
choices.narrative: You make room for the whole truth and carry some of it afterward.

choices.title: Protect your capacity
choices.detail: Admit that care has a limit tonight.
choices.narrative: You draw a boundary before concern becomes collapse.

events.headline: Ambition Meets A Narrow Opening
events.detail: A volatile labor market creates one risky opening that fits your appetite for motion.

choices.title: Take the opening
choices.detail: Trade stability for a larger ceiling.
choices.narrative: You step through before certainty can catch up.

choices.title: Keep your footing
choices.detail: Let this chance belong to someone else.
choices.narrative: The opening closes, leaving relief and a question behind.

events.headline: Your Independence Leaves Help Outside
events.detail: Someone offers practical help, but accepting it would expose how much you have been carrying alone.

choices.title: Let them help
choices.detail: Trade control for breathing room.
choices.narrative: The load gets lighter before the vulnerability does.

choices.title: Carry it yourself
choices.detail: Keep the terms entirely yours.
choices.narrative: You preserve control and absorb the full cost.

events.headline: Flexibility Defuses The Workplace Standoff
events.detail: Two rigid positions stall the room until your ability to translate the conflict becomes visible.

choices.title: Translate both sides
choices.detail: Spend social capital on a workable middle.
choices.narrative: Nobody gets everything, and the work starts moving again.

choices.title: Stay out of it
choices.detail: Keep someone else's conflict off your back.
choices.narrative: You protect your energy while the standoff hardens.

events.headline: Routine Outlasts A Health Setback
events.detail: A chronic condition disrupts the week, but the routine you kept building is still there.

choices.title: Keep the routine
choices.detail: Choose consistency over immediate relief.
choices.narrative: The routine does not cure you; it keeps the setback from taking everything.

choices.title: Change the plan
choices.detail: Adapt the routine to the body you have now.
choices.narrative: You loosen the structure without abandoning care.

events.headline: Contentment Protects What Growth Threatened
events.detail: A bigger opportunity would improve the numbers and consume the ordinary life you worked to keep.

choices.title: Protect the ordinary
choices.detail: Keep time and accept the smaller ceiling.
choices.narrative: Nothing dramatic happens. The life you value remains inhabitable.

choices.title: Take the growth
choices.detail: Use the opening and absorb the absence.
choices.narrative: The numbers improve while home learns your new shape.

events.headline: Private Practice Becomes Visible Skill
events.detail: Hours spent away from the room have quietly become competence that other people can finally see.

choices.title: Show the work
choices.detail: Let private ability become public evidence.
choices.narrative: The work survives attention, and so do you.

choices.title: Keep it private
choices.detail: Protect the practice from outside judgment.
choices.narrative: The skill deepens without becoming an opportunity.

events.headline: Risk Feels Different In Thin Times
events.detail: The same gamble carries farther when public support is too thin to catch a bad landing.

choices.title: Take the gamble
choices.detail: Keep the upside and the exposed floor.
choices.narrative: You move before fear can turn into policy.

choices.title: Respect the floor
choices.detail: Treat the missing safety net as real.
choices.narrative: You keep your footing and watch the possible future pass.

events.headline: Driven Pace Leaves Someone Waiting
events.detail: The work keeps moving, but someone close has stopped pretending the absence is temporary.

choices.title: Make room
choices.detail: Protect the bond and surrender some momentum.
choices.narrative: You leave the work unfinished and arrive while repair is still possible.

choices.title: Keep pushing
choices.detail: Protect the opening and accept the distance.
choices.narrative: The work advances. The silence at home becomes less ambiguous.

events.headline: Content Restores What Ambition Kept Spending
events.detail: A quieter season offers recovery without pretending that rest is free.

choices.title: Protect the quiet
choices.detail: Take less and recover more.
choices.narrative: The pace softens enough for your body to believe you.

choices.title: Use the margin
choices.detail: Turn recovery into another push.
choices.narrative: The rest becomes fuel instead of a destination.

events.headline: Contentment Meets A Rising Cost Floor
events.detail: A sustainable pace becomes harder to defend while ordinary costs climb.

choices.title: Take extra work
choices.detail: Trade recovery for financial room.
choices.narrative: You meet the bill by spending energy you meant to keep.

choices.title: Keep the pace
choices.detail: Protect yourself and absorb the squeeze.
choices.narrative: The days remain livable. The ledger does not become kinder.

events.headline: Empathy Turns Conflict Into Honest Repair
events.detail: You understand what was said and what fear was hiding underneath it.

choices.title: Stay in the room
choices.detail: Use understanding without erasing yourself.
choices.narrative: The conflict becomes specific enough to repair.

choices.title: Set the boundary
choices.detail: Refuse to carry both sides.
choices.narrative: You leave the problem where it belongs, even though connection cools.

events.headline: Empathy Absorbs More Than It Should
events.detail: Someone else's crisis has quietly become the structure of your week.

choices.title: Keep carrying
choices.detail: Protect them and absorb the cost.
choices.narrative: They get room to breathe. Your own margin disappears.

choices.title: Return the weight
choices.detail: Offer care with a limit.
choices.narrative: The boundary stings, then makes the relationship more honest.

events.headline: Self Reliance Builds A Private Buffer
events.detail: Quiet preparation leaves you less exposed when the numbers turn hostile.

choices.title: Keep control
choices.detail: Use the buffer without inviting help.
choices.narrative: The crisis stays contained, and so do you.

choices.title: Share the plan
choices.detail: Trade some control for support.
choices.narrative: The buffer becomes something another person can help protect.

events.headline: Self Reliance Refuses Needed Help
events.detail: A problem has grown beyond what private competence can solve cleanly.

choices.title: Let them help
choices.detail: Accept dependence without surrendering agency.
choices.narrative: Relief arrives with the discomfort of being witnessed.

choices.title: Handle it alone
choices.detail: Keep control and carry the full cost.
choices.narrative: Nobody can disappoint you; nobody can lighten it either.

events.headline: Outgoing Visibility Creates A Real Opening
events.detail: A loose connection remembers your name when an opportunity appears.

choices.title: Follow the opening
choices.detail: Spend social capital and show up.
choices.narrative: Familiarity becomes access, though participation still costs.

choices.title: Keep the evening
choices.detail: Protect your time instead.
choices.narrative: The door closes without becoming a catastrophe.

events.headline: The Crowd Takes More Than Expected
events.detail: Being available to everyone has made your own needs difficult to hear.

choices.title: Leave early
choices.detail: Accept disappointing people and recover.
choices.narrative: The messages keep arriving after you stop answering.

choices.title: Keep circulating
choices.detail: Protect visibility and spend the energy.
choices.narrative: You remain central to the room and absent from yourself.

events.headline: Reserved Attention Catches What Others Miss
events.detail: Watching before speaking reveals a detail that changes the work.

choices.title: Name what you saw
choices.detail: Trade privacy for useful visibility.
choices.narrative: The room turns toward you because the observation holds.

choices.title: Keep observing
choices.detail: Protect the private advantage.
choices.narrative: You retain the insight and surrender the credit.

events.headline: Silence Lets An Important Bond Drift
events.detail: Someone who once understood your quiet has begun reading it as distance.

choices.title: Say the difficult part
choices.detail: Risk exposure before distance hardens.
choices.narrative: The words arrive awkwardly and still arrive in time.

choices.title: Wait for ease
choices.detail: Keep the quiet and accept the ambiguity.
choices.narrative: Nothing explodes. Something important keeps thinning.

events.headline: Adventure Finds An Unclaimed Opening
events.detail: A volatile opportunity exists largely because safer people declined it.

choices.title: Move first
choices.detail: Take the exposed upside.
choices.narrative: Speed becomes leverage before it becomes evidence.

choices.title: Demand evidence
choices.detail: Let uncertainty settle first.
choices.narrative: You keep the floor and surrender the first-mover advantage.

events.headline: Caution Preserves Room During A Shock
events.detail: The buffer looked excessive until the world supplied a use for it.

choices.title: Use the buffer
choices.detail: Stabilize the present without pretending it is free.
choices.narrative: Preparation turns panic into a smaller decision.

choices.title: Spend for position
choices.detail: Use safety to take a measured opening.
choices.narrative: The buffer becomes a launchpad instead of a wall.

events.headline: Caution Lets The Window Close
events.detail: More evidence arrives only after the useful moment has started disappearing.

choices.title: Move before certainty
choices.detail: Take a bounded risk while the route exists.
choices.narrative: The decision feels early because it is still useful.

choices.title: Keep the floor
choices.detail: Protect what cannot be replaced.
choices.narrative: The opportunity passes. The floor remains yours.

events.headline: Adaptability Finds Another Workable Route
events.detail: The original plan fails without making the underlying goal impossible.

choices.title: Take the new route
choices.detail: Trade sunk effort for forward motion.
choices.narrative: The route changes while the purpose survives.

choices.title: Repair the original
choices.detail: Keep faith with the first plan.
choices.narrative: You recover some mastery at the cost of time.

events.headline: Constant Pivots Prevent Roots From Forming
events.detail: Every change has been reasonable, but together they have interrupted compounding.

choices.title: Stay through discomfort
choices.detail: Let one commitment become deep.
choices.narrative: Novelty fades and mastery finally gets time.

choices.title: Pivot again
choices.detail: Protect fit and surrender accumulated position.
choices.narrative: The new route fits better and starts closer to zero.

events.headline: Steadfast Practice Compounds Into Mastery
events.detail: Repetition that once looked ordinary has become difficult for others to imitate.

choices.title: Keep the routine
choices.detail: Take the earned depth and its narrowness.
choices.narrative: The practice stops looking repetitive and starts looking rare.

choices.title: Change the pattern
choices.detail: Protect flexibility before mastery becomes a cage.
choices.narrative: You surrender some edge and recover a wider life.

events.headline: Methodical Preparation Finds Quiet Leverage
events.detail: A controlled plan creates an opening that spectacle would have missed.

choices.title: Use the leverage
choices.detail: Move carefully while the advantage exists.
choices.narrative: Preparation becomes movement instead of permanent rehearsal.

choices.title: Keep preparing
choices.detail: Protect the floor and risk overplanning.
choices.narrative: The plan improves after the opening has narrowed.

events.headline: Social Caretaker Carries Everyone Too Long
events.detail: Connection and care have combined into a role nobody remembers to relieve.

choices.title: Ask for relief
choices.detail: Risk disappointing people and recover capacity.
choices.narrative: The network becomes mutual or reveals that it never was.

choices.title: Keep everyone held
choices.detail: Protect belonging and absorb the load.
choices.narrative: Nobody falls tonight. You carry tomorrow's cost.

events.headline: Social Catalyst Turns Strangers Into Momentum
events.detail: Energy and risk tolerance make a temporary room behave like a network.

choices.title: Gather the room
choices.detail: Create momentum and carry the exposure.
choices.narrative: A crowd becomes a route, and the route remembers your name.

choices.title: Let it stay casual
choices.detail: Keep the night from becoming work.
choices.narrative: The room remains pleasant and temporary.

events.headline: Restless Adapter Leaves Before Roots Form
events.detail: The next possibility arrives before the current commitment has had time to compound.

choices.title: Take the next route
choices.detail: Choose possibility over accumulated position.
choices.narrative: The horizon opens while another set of roots comes loose.

choices.title: Stay this time
choices.detail: Accept boredom long enough for depth.
choices.narrative: The urge passes slowly. The commitment remains.

events.headline: Deliberate Individualist Protects A Difficult Boundary
events.detail: A careful refusal preserves autonomy while making the social cost impossible to ignore.

choices.title: Hold the boundary
choices.detail: Keep control and accept the distance.
choices.narrative: The refusal is clean enough to survive the anger around it.

choices.title: Negotiate the edge
choices.detail: Trade some autonomy for a workable bond.
choices.narrative: The boundary bends without disappearing.
